data.games_lines: nflverse schedules (games.csv) - includes spread_line, moneylines, rest days, coaches, QBs. Book lines used as BENCHMARK ONLY, never model inputs.
data.team_stats: nflverse stats_player weekly 2010-2025 aggregated to team-game
data.talent: returning/incoming production shares from stats_player player-seasons

moneyline_test.reading: LOSS vs closing moneyline on all three metrics

learner_selection: Ridge alpha=10 beat HistGradientBoosting on validation (10.564 vs 10.766); ridge shipped.
gate_verdict: descriptive_failed_close - beats Elo with a settled interval, loses to the closing market with a settled interval on both spread and moneyline. Same shape as the CFB gates. NOT shipped as picks; measurement only.
known_gaps: OC/DC features not yet in (nflverse has head coach only; coordinators need PFR staff pages)
injury points are raw report counts, not snap/starter-weighted
no weather/turf features yet (games.csv has temp/wind/roof/surface unused)
